text: こわい　ほど　つよい　ポケモンが　せいそく　してるぞ！

structure.jp: こわい　ほど　つよい　ポケモンが
せいそく　してるぞ！

patterns.name: 〜ほど
patterns.span: こわい　ほど　つよい
patterns.explanation: ほど says how far something goes: so much that the word before it is true. こわい　ほど　つよい = 'so strong it's scary'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says a state that holds now. Here it is shortened to てる, as people do when talking. せいそく　してる = 'are living there'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, mostly male way to push a point or give a warning. せいそく　してるぞ = 'they live there, I'm telling you'.
